ov: White or buff herons with long legs that grow fine, milky-white plumes in the breeding season. There is no clear line between egrets and herons. They live on every continent, in fresh and salt-water marshes.
rg: Every continent, avoiding the coldest regions, deserts and high mountains.
fx: The word egret comes from the French aigrette, meaning both "silver heron" and "brush".
Great egrets nest in colonies in trees close to water.
